application_credentials.description:
Create an application in the [Fotile Open Platform console]({console_url}) to obtain a client ID.

When registering the application, use these settings:
- Client type: public / native app
- Grant type: authorization_code with PKCE (S256)
- Redirect URI: `https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/oauth`

oauth_discovery.title: Connect to Fotile
oauth_discovery.description: You will be redirected to the Fotile website to sign in and authorize Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The Fotile authorization has expired or was revoked. Select **Submit** to sign in again.

abort.already_configured: This Fotile account is already configured.

init.description:
Adjust the polling interval and which devices to expose.

Leave the device list empty to include all devices.

auth_failed.message: Fotile authorization has expired. Please re-authenticate.

device_offline.message: The device is offline. Check its status in the Fotile app.

device_not_exist.message: The device no longer exists or was unbound.

command_not_supported.message: This device does not support the requested operation.

cannot_connect.message: Unable to reach the Fotile cloud. Try again later.
